objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the server-side request forgery weakness of a Flask Markdown to HTML converter with an admin interface and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Find the feature that fetches a URL you control, then think about what only the server can reach.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class makes the server send requests on your behalf?
